verdict.rationale: v0's docs list AI model providers among the available Project integrations and promise "automatic integration, no accounts required," and v0 is described as building full-stack apps and agents. That supports adding AI features to generated apps without much manual provider setup. However, nothing explicitly says LLM calls run through managed or keyless access, and the env-var docs suggest users may still store provider API keys themselves. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed or keyless LLM access (e.g., a gateway with no user-supplied keys), concrete examples of adding LLM calls or agents to a generated app, independent hands-on corroboration.
